contexts.text: The correspondences by which, in each and all things, the Word has been written, possess such force and power that they may be called the force and power of the Divine omnipotence; for through them the Natural acts conjoinedly with the Spiritual, and the Spiritual with the Natural; thus all things of Heaven with all things of the world. Hence it is that the two sacraments are correspondences of spiritual things with natural. This is the source of their virtue and power.
